verdict.rationale: Stripe documents creating, customizing, and sending Stripe-hosted invoices from the Dashboard with no code, which covers the core hosted-invoice part of the story. Online payment on the invoice is only implied by its being Stripe-hosted, and nothing in the pack documents automatic invoice reminders. Smart Retries re-attempts failed payments, which is a different feature from reminders. Missing for 10: documented online payment on the hosted invoice page, automatic payment reminder emails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders

citations.quote: Create, customize, and send a Stripe-hosted invoice from the Dashboard, with no code required.
Customize invoices: Customize the content and branding of your invoices.
